info.name: Gladia Control AudioToText Pre-recorded V2 API
info.description: Gladia AI audio infrastructure API for speech-to-text transcription via REST and WebSocket. Supports asynchronous pre-recorded audio processing and real-time live transcription with speaker diarization, automatic language detection across 100+ languages, and audio intelligence features.
